log.text: Liftoff. The Moon in the window: 28° left. Fuel for 48 s of burn.
Target centred in the window (+4°). DNp20: right 35 Hz, left 0 Hz.
Out of the dense air: altitude 36, speed 17 u/s.
Asteroid A-8 (radius 3) passed 1.6 u from the hull.
The Moon is blinding. The retina turns its sensitivity down to 48%.
Target held centred for 4.8 s without a break.
Flight computer: flip, engines first. Altitude 164, closing 40 u/s. The pilot's lever is off for the manoeuvre.
Meteor M-5 in the window (21° right, 30% of the Moon's light). The pilot held its course.
Flip complete, landing burn. The pilot now looks through the landing camera; its lever moves the rocket sideways.
The pad never came to the centre of the camera: closest 6° left.
Flight computer: altitude 20. Below this the sideways speed is limited in proportion to height; the direction stays the pilot's.
Touchdown: 1.5 u/s down, 0.6 u/s sideways, ground slope 10°, 5.6 u from the centre of the pad.

The legs' signal reached 2,522 leg mechanosensory neurons. In 0.5 s the ascending neurons (legs → brain) fired 16,019 spikes, against 0 before contact. Strongest in the brain: PEN_a(PEN1) (+1,833), PEN_b(PEN2) (+1,700), cells with no named type (+1,627).

cause: LANDED OFF THE PAD, 6 u from it. Slope 10°, the legs held. The crew is fine.
